# Packages the panel scripts, the compute stages, and their shared helpers
# actually import.
#
# GENERATED — do not edit. `make panel-packages` rewrites this file, header and
# all, from the scripts themselves. Change what a script loads, run it again.
#
# Under CLOSURE_CHECK_MODE=STRICT every package listed here must match the
# version recorded in precovid-repro's docs/environment/package_versions.tsv.
# Drift in the rest of that ~436-package closure is reported as WARN: it cannot
# reach a panel, so it cannot change one.
#
# Derived from every .R under scripts/10_build_panels/, every helper in
# scripts/lib/, and the R drivers of Stages 05 to 08. The generator matches
# text, so a package named only inside a comment or a message string is included
# too — harmless, since such a package is in the reference and matches.
#
# The compute stages are gated for a stronger reason than the panels. A panel
# script draws what it is handed; Stage 05 FITS the table ED3A is then drawn
# from, Stage 06 the one ED3E is drawn from, Stage 07 the one ED4G and FIG3EFG
# are drawn from, and Stage 08 the PLIER fits, so which variancePartition,
# edgeR, limma or PLIER they ran under decides the numbers in those figures and
# not merely their appearance. limma in particular: eBayes()'s `legacy` argument,
# and the estimator it selects, moves every moderated t and p in the fit.
#
# Deliberately excluded, and why — all of it in scripts/lib/derive_panel_packages.sh:
#
#   base, grDevices, grid, stats, utils, methods, ...
#       base-priority, versioned with R itself. REQUIRED_R_VERSION covers them.
#
#   MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData, MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionAnalysis
#       the reference manifest records the versions from BEFORE `make all` runs
#       on precovid-repro, so checking them here would fail a correctly updated
#       library. The version each panel was actually drawn from is recorded
#       per-PDF in outputs/panels/export_manifest.tsv.
#
#   MotrpacHumanPreSuspension
#       a third package the legacy figure scripts called plot_single_feature()
#       from. No script here names it.
#
# Some entries reach a panel at RUN TIME and are named in no script; the
# generator's RUNTIME_EXTRA list carries them and says why for each. No entry is
# absent from the reference manifest.
